## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

This is a four-fascicle Late-Ming "concise notes" (*jiǎnzhù* 簡註) commentary on Kumārajīva's [KR6i0218](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6i/KR6i0218) *Sīyì Fàntiān suǒwèn jīng*, by the Cáodòng 曹洞 Chán master Zhànrán Yuánchéng 湛然圓澄 ([圓澄](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E5%9C%93%E6%BE%84); 1561–1626). The commentary is typical of late-Ming Chán-flavored sūtra exegesis: terse glosses on the canonical text, paired with brief Chán-style remarks on the doctrinal heart of each chapter.

**Abstract**

A late-Ming devotional and exegetical work attached to Kumārajīva's *Sīyì Fàntiān suǒwèn jīng*. Yuánchéng was a major Cáodòng revivalist active at Yúnmén 雲門 in Zhèjiāng and is better known for his Chán records (*Zhànrán Yuánchéng chánshī yǔlù* 湛然圓澄禪師語錄 ([KR6q0374](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6q/KR6q0374)), *Kǎigǔ lù* 慨古錄 ([KR6q0171](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6q/KR6q0171)), *Zōngmén huòwèn* 宗門或問 ([宗門或問](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Titles/%E5%AE%97%E9%96%80%E6%88%96%E5%95%8F))). The *Jiǎnzhù* offers a window onto how late-Ming Chán reread classical Mahāyāna scripture.
